decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved documents/drawings :

Location Plan, P01 B,  P02 A, P 03 A, P 04A, P 05A, P 06A, P 07A, P08A, P 09A, P 10A, P 11A, P 12A, Design & Access Statement (Anna Williamson Architects - 30/07/2025), Heritage Statement (Nicole Ansari - July 2025), Daylight & Sunlight Report - Right of Light Consulting Surveyors - 31/07/2025), Tree Report - S1629-J1-R1 - John Cromar�s Arboricultural Company Limited

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1 and D2 of the Camden Local Plan 2017. 
Condition : 4 - Before the relevant part of the work is begun, detailed drawings, or samples of materials as appropriate, in respect of the following, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority: 

a) Details of the junction of the lead capped stucco coping on the front elevation to the side parapet (including detail drawings at a scale of 1:20 or less)

b) Details of the proposed small canopy and brackets to the entrance door (including detail drawings at a scale of 1:20 or less) 

The relevant part of the works shall be carried out in accordance with the details thus approved and all approved samples shall be retained on site during the course of the works. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1 and D2 of the Camden Local Plan 2017.

description:
Extension of roof, extension of rear first floor outrigger, works to elevations including repair, general refurbishment and replacement door and windows.
The existing first floor outrigger connects to and takes support from the grade II listed wall behind.  Structural connections and weatherproofing to be altered.
subdivision_of_building: Ground floor entrance, entire 1st and 2nd floors and roof, forming the full demise of the maisonette property.
